instances.claim: This tells me that the draft has already shown me cents selling for thousands of dollars, so that 'here we are' names two facts I have both been given.
instances.why: Line 7's absurdity is earned by lines 2-3 (a cent buys nothing, costs two and a half), but line 8 presupposes a cent fetching thousands, which no earlier line establishes — the only valuations in the piece are one cent and two and a half cents. Line 9 then asserts that both states actually obtain, treating the unestablished one as something the draft has demonstrated.
